shellDisabled:
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
spawnSync(invocation.command, invocation.args, { shell: false });
shellEnabled:
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
spawnSync(invocation.command, invocation.args, { shell: true });
customShell:
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
spawnSync(invocation.command, invocation.args, { shell: "/bin/sh" });
